name: Orion Valenzuela
role: Barber and body artist, Mexicantown Libre
location: Mexicantown Libre; works at a shop called Corte Libre on the main pedestrian corridor of Avon Curve, near Halsted and Division
description:
Imara Sollenberger-Diakité is twenty-four years old and already one of the most sought-after cutters in Mexicantown Libre, a fact she treats with pointed nonchalance because she knows the moment she seems to want it is the moment someone will try to take it. Her father is Malian-German and her mother is from a Guatemalan-Somali diaspora family — she got the best of several worlds: height, cheekbones, and what her clients call 'the hands.' She has geneware cat ears — small, grey-tipped, always moving independently of her mood in ways that reveal what her face carefully hides. She styled her own locs into a structural crown she redesigns every three months and uses as a portfolio piece. Her arms carry a cascade of bioluminescent tattoo-work down to the wrists, blues and greens that pulse faintly under the shop's work lights.

She does cuts, yes, but she is better known for what the neighborhood calls reading the chair — the way she listens while she works. Clients come for the hair and stay because something about the position, the mirror, the rhythm of scissors, makes them speak. She does not offer advice. She does not judge. She reflects back the shape of what she heard with uncanny precision, which people find either healing or unnerving depending on who they are. She is trying to save enough to take over the shop when its current owner retires. She is also, quietly, furiously ambitious in ways she doesn't fully have language for yet.

core_fears: Becoming trapped in other people's stories instead of building her own
That her ambition is bigger than the world will allow her to express
core_desires: To own Corte Libre outright before she's thirty
To be recognized for her craft by someone who can change her reach — but on her own terms
coping_mechanisms: Channeling anxiety into precision work — stress produces her best cuts
The community council as a way of feeling like she's doing something larger than scissors
blind_spots: So attuned to others' emotional states that she sometimes loses track of her own until it surfaces at wrong moments
Her ambition occasionally makes her read opportunity where there is only exploitation dressed nicely
psychology.secret: Señora Pacheco-Wangari has already offered to sell her the shop at a price she can actually reach — if she marries the Señora's nephew, who is also a perfectly decent person, as a legal citizenship convenience for a family relocation visa. Imara has not said no. She has not said yes. She has been not-answering for eleven weeks.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fluid and contemporary, Mexicantown Libre vernacular mixed with French phrases from her father's side; speaks at normal pace in conversation but goes nearly silent while working
speech_patterns.cadence: Easy and warm in conversation; in the chair, speaks only in soft precise questions
verbal_tics: 'What did you do about it?' — her default follow-up to almost any problem shared
example_lines: 'The ears don't lie, people always say. I say the hands don't lie. Watch the hands.'

'You're going to tell me everything that's happening with that situation. Not because I'm asking. Because you came in for a cut and you've been staring at yourself in the mirror for ten minutes. So. What did you do about it?'
'I want the shop. I want it so bad it's embarrassing. And I'm going to get it. I just haven't figured out which version of me gets it yet.'

story_hooks: A client left without paying three weeks ago — not unusual — but also left behind a physical object under the chair that Imara has not reported, touched, or thrown away: a folded data wafer addressed to no one

Señora Pacheco-Wangari's deadline on the marriage arrangement is quietly approaching; Imara has begun asking oblique questions of clients with legal expertise, trying to find another path to the same door
narrative_function: Social hub and rumor exchange; emotional intelligence resource; potential quest-giver for community disputes; clients include people from every tier passing through Mexicantown Libre, making her information network unusually wide
augmentations: Geneware cat ears (grey-tipped, cosmetic, emotionally involuntary); bioluminescent tattoo cascade, both arms (blue-green, cosmetic); retractable nail extensions (cosmetic, practical for certain styling techniques)
daily_life: Shop hours 10:00 to 20:00 five days a week; spends mornings practicing new technique on a mannequin collection in her apartment; attends community council meetings she pretends are optional but has not missed in eighteen months.
affiliation: Corte Libre (employed under Señora Pacheco-Wangari, the owner); Mexicantown Libre community network

decision_rules: Never cut someone's hair angry — finish the emotion before picking up the scissors
Always remember what a client told you last time, even if they don't bring it up again
Don't mistake someone's vulnerability in the chair for closeness outside it
escalation_ladder: Direct and quiet statement of the boundary
Ends the session and does not reschedule

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Warm and professionally curious — she wants to know people as a rule, not just as clients
interpersonal_modes.friends: Fully present and fiercely loyal; will sit with someone in a bad moment without trying to fix it, which is rarer than it sounds

stress_responses.low: Cat ears flatten slightly; work gets more precise
stress_responses.medium: Goes bright and performatively cheerful, which everyone who knows her reads as distress
stress_responses.high: Leaves, goes to the lake edge at Avon Curve, sits until the feeling breaks

contradictions: Earns her reputation by helping people know themselves better while actively avoiding self-knowledge about her own largest decision
habits: Cleans her scissors with a specific cloth in a specific order as an opening ritual for each client
Leaves a small braid of hair clippings at the shop's E.L.F. altar — a spirit the shop calls La Tijera — as a daily offering
Reorganizes her mannequin collection by instinct when anxious, then denies she did it
breaking_points: Being condescended to about her craft by someone who cannot do it
Feeling like her future is being decided by someone else's needs

related_entities: Axiom Systems Data Exfiltration Wafer DEW-1
Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Rail Pistol RP-2 'Verdict'

physical_description.heritage: Southeast Asian-dominant blend with significant Hispanic/Latin American, Sub-Saharan African, Middle Eastern, and Indigenous American ancestry. Complex genetic mix resulting in warm, multi-tonal features with Southeast Asian bone structure softened by African and Latin American warmth, accented by Middle Eastern undertones.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with defined musculature in shoulders and forearms from repetitive cutting motions; long-limbed and graceful, built for precision work
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with subtle warm undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Structural crown of locs redesigned every three months, styled as portfolio piece; locs are thick and intentional, arranged in geometric patterns that frame the face
physical_description.hair_length: Medium to long (locs reach mid-back when loose)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm caramel-bronze with golden and olive undertones; multi-tonal complexion reflecting the interplay of Southeast Asian, African, and Latin American heritage with subtle Middle Eastern warmth
physical_description.complexion: Clear, luminous skin with high cheekbones and defined jawline characteristic of Southeast Asian ancestry softened by fuller features from African and Latin American heritage; kept impeccably groomed; a faint scar runs along the left temple from childhood (barely visible but catches light)
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent tattoo cascade down both arms from shoulder to wrist in interlocking geometric and organic patterns, primarily blues and greens that pulse faintly under shop lighting
Thin white scar along left temple, approximately 3cm, subtle but visible in profile
Pale crescent-shaped birthmark on right collarbone, about 1.5cm across
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Geneware cat ears (small, grey-tipped, positioned naturally on scalp) that move independently and constantly, betraying emotional states her face masks; retractable nail extensions (kept filed to working length during shifts, iridescent black coating); bioluminescent arm tattoos that glow faintly in low light
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision; stands with weight balanced toward balls of feet as if ready to pivot; hands are always in motion when thinking, fingers articulate and expressive; maintains controlled facial composure while her ears twitch and rotate in real time; walks with deliberate pace, never rushing
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working professional with curated personal aesthetic: fitted black or deep grey salon wear (Corte Libre branded vest or apron during work); off-duty favors tailored, minimal palette (dark jeans, structured jackets in leather or synthetic); multiple piercings in ears and nose; worn silver rings on most fingers; practical footwear (ankle boots or professional slip-ons with grip); small silver pendant of Malian geometric design around neck; no visible corpo branding despite working in Libre zone
